notes.artefacts: two of Carlton's three notes (bigger, different flowers) are not addressed

visual.summary: Level 2 adds hedges round two beds, lanterns and a composter, but the beds are still all poppies and the garden is still small.
problems: Carlton asked for different flowers: the beds are all red poppies. Mix 4 or 5 kinds (cornflower, allium, oxeye daisy, azure bluet, red and orange tulips, lilac or rose bush as tall flowers) in rows per bed
Carlton asked for it to be bigger: it is still about 9 x 9. Go to 11 x 11 or 13 x 13 with more beds or a centre feature
Add a trellis, a bench under a tree or a small pond so L2 has a centre of interest

It now stands on a one-block cobblestone plinth with a stair step, which fixes the sinking. Check that Carlton is happy with a raised plinth; a garden floor level with the grass (beds edged by logs or a low fence) would look more natural

visual.summary: A proper cottage garden: a cherry and a birch in the corners, azalea bushes, a flowering arbor at the entrance, benches on three sides and many kinds of flowers in curved borders.
problems: Layer 0 is now level with the grass (meta.groundLayer 0): in game the builders never dig or replace ground, so the mod side still has to support setting paths and beds into the lawn before this can be built as drawn
